result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the second restaurant card and some horizontal carousel content is clipped at the screen edges.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second popular restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its title/details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content, or ensure the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The rightmost cards and category chip are visibly cut off at the viewport edge. This may be intentional horizontal scrolling, but there is no clear visual affordance indicating more content is available.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel behavior but add a subtle peek/scroll indicator or ensure clipping communicates that the rows are horizontally scrollable.
